Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.conceptmap

Class ConceptMapContent

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.conceptmap.ConceptMapContent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ConceptMapContent extends Object implements Serializable
The mappings of one concept map at one resolution: the canonical URL, the version resolved where known, and the deduplicated rows in first-seen order.

Every source of a concept map converges on this shape through one of two factories. fromResource(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ConceptMap, int) converts an R4 ConceptMap, applying the official R4 to R5 conversion of equivalences and rejecting content that the flat rows of a concept map relation cannot carry; fromMappings(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.Iterable<au.csiro.pathling.terminology.conceptmap.ConceptMapping>, int) deduplicates rows that a source has already built. Both apply the caller's cap once the rows are complete. A source that holds a ConceptMap's values rather than the resource builds each row with mapping(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Enumerations.ConceptMapEquivalence), the conversion fromResource applies.

  • Method Details

    • fromResource

      @Nonnull public static ConceptMapContent fromResource(@Nonnull ConceptMap conceptMap, int maxMappings)
      Converts an R4 ConceptMap resource to the rows of a concept map relation, walking group, element and target in document order. Each target whose equivalence is not unmatched is one row; each element with at least one unmatched target is one no-mapping row with a null target code, display and relationship. group.unmapped is ignored and an element without targets contributes nothing. The whole resource is walked before the cap is applied, so a fault is reported even where it lies beyond the cap.
      Parameters:
      conceptMap - the resource
      maxMappings - the largest number of rows the caller will accept
      Returns:
      the content
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the resource carries no url
      ConceptMapContentException - if a group has no source, a target carries dependsOn or product, an element has no code, a target whose equivalence is not unmatched has no code, or a target has no equivalence
      ConceptMapLimitExceededException - if the deduplicated rows exceed maxMappings

    • fromMappings

      @Nonnull public static ConceptMapContent fromMappings(@Nonnull String url, @Nullable String version, @Nonnull Iterable<ConceptMapping> mappings, int maxMappings)
      Builds the content of a concept map from rows, deduplicating on identity and keeping the first occurrence of each.
      Parameters:
      url - the canonical URL of the concept map
      version - the version resolved, or null where none is known
      mappings - the rows, in the order they were produced
      maxMappings - the largest number of rows the caller will accept
      Returns:
      the content
      Throws:
      ConceptMapLimitExceededException - once the retained rows exceed maxMappings; the rest of mappings is not consumed

    • mapping

      @Nonnull public static ConceptMapping mapping(@Nonnull String groupSource, @Nullable String groupSourceVersion, @Nullable String groupTarget, @Nullable String groupTargetVersion, @Nonnull String sourceCode, @Nullable String sourceDisplay, @Nullable String targetCode, @Nullable String targetDisplay, @Nonnull Enumerations.ConceptMapEquivalence equivalence)
      Builds the row for one target of an element, from the values the ConceptMap gives the target, its element and its group, as fromResource(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ConceptMap, int) does once the content has been checked. A blank value is absent. A group's version is its explicit sourceVersion or targetVersion where it has one, and otherwise the part of its canonical after the first |, which is then removed from the system. An unmatched target is a no-mapping row, whatever code it carries.
      Parameters:
      groupSource - the source of the group, which must not be blank
      groupSourceVersion - the sourceVersion of the group, or null
      groupTarget - the target of the group, or null
      groupTargetVersion - the targetVersion of the group, or null
      sourceCode - the code of the element, which must not be blank
      sourceDisplay - the display of the element, or null
      targetCode - the code of the target, which must not be blank unless the target is unmatched
      targetDisplay - the display of the target, or null
      equivalence - the equivalence of the target
      Returns:
      the row
